items.title: Lucky Skyblock
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Start with nothing, explore the different islands and test your luck. Will you be able to defeat the Ender Dragon?

+2 free skins!
+Craftable Lucky Blocks!
+Single and multiplayer friendly
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Squid World
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Welcome to Squid World. A new sky adventure map with huge squid structured islands. And every island has its own secrets to discover! Lets start the new adventure!

- An objectives book with dozens of challenges to complete!
- An new epic Skyblock Adventure!
- Dungeons to defeat and secrets to discover
- Tons of fun alone or with your friends!
- By Pixelusion & Hylarion

items.title: Swamp Creatures
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
The muddy creature inside of you wants to climb out of the murky waters. Crawl out of the swamp at night to scare your friends!

+ 8 HD muddy creatures!
+ Free skin: Frog Monk
+ Muddy, slimy & smelly! 

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Monster High Teens
items.creator: FTB
items.description:
The first day of high school didn't go as planned, everyone turned into a monster. Discover your newest character with all your friends!

+ 12 Monster skins!
+ Free skin: Orion
+ Monster, fashion & trendy!

By FTB

items.title: Nature Friends
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
You're one with nature and its colors. Explore the green side of the earth while taking a walk with your friends!

+ 12 colorful skins!
+ Free skin: Bach
+ Nature, colorful & fashion!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Rich Teens
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description: Do you have too much money? Be a rich teen with these 10 stylish and trendy skins!

items.title: Red and White
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Red or white? These teens are color enthusiasts and can't wait to try out the new shades! We are ready for a world just in red and white. Who says you can't be a fashion guru just with two colors? Welcome to this new universe where everyone tries to style minimalistic. So get into the game and be creative!

+ 1 free skin
+ 16 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Rappers Paradise
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
The nightclubs are teeming with life! Everybody has a great time even though it's the end of summer. Remember there is no right time to party! The parking lot is full, and everybody wants to join the latest concert. Seeing your favorite rapper live is a great feeling. So pack your bags and hit the road!

+ 1 free skin
+ 16 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Crazy Animal Friends
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Animals are back in town and ready to have fun! Meet a wide variety of cute animals and become best friends. You can find Dinos, Ducks, Foxes, and even Panda bears! So, let your imagination grow and integrate yourself into this new society. Everyone is friendly here and ready to party!

+ 1 free skin
+ 16 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Forsaken Island
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Brave great dangers with the newest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! A terrible storm has left you washed up on the shores of an island long cursed with creatures that hunt humankind. With no ready means of escape, your survival is a matter of your wit and prowess. Can you combat the evils that live here and discover mighty artifacts left by heroes before you?

items.title: Monochrome
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
Are you ready to begin a colorful adventure? Shine in any color you want with the Monochrome skin pack!

~10 monochromatic skins bright with personality
~Shine in your favorite color
~By Entity Builds

items.title: Legend Texture Pack
items.creator: Syclone Studios
items.description:
An immersive survival experience. Legend adds beauty and readability while keeping the original Minecraft essence.

+ Designed for the survival player
+ Updated to 1.20!
+ High quality pixel art
+ All blocks work in harmony
+ From Joe Collins & Syclone Studios
items.changelog: Updated to 1.20! Wild Update and Trails & Tales ready Improved Tools, Weapons, Food, and more items Improved Logs, Trapdoors, and more blocks

items.title: Mob Style
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Transform into a mob-style skin with vivid and vibrant fits. From the infinite world, all the way to the end. Protect and defend your realm to become the most styled gamer Minecraft has ever seen!

items.title: Halloween Drip
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Transform into a Halloween drip skin with spooky HD vivid and vibrant shades. From the infinite world, all the way to the end. Protect and defend your realm to become the scariest gamer Minecraft has ever seen!

items.title: Halloween Teens Skin Pack
items.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming
items.description:
These teens are dressed for a spooky Halloween night! There are outfits ranging from a pumpkin mask, nurse and witch costume to some scary skeletons and more! Roleplay, trick or treat or scare your friends in these incredible Halloween teen skins!

- 10 skins
- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming

items.title: Halloween Terror
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
Halloween is the perfect time to dress up in costumes! Ranging from the cute and spooky, put on yours and scare the candy out of your neighbors!

- Super scary HD skins
- Ideal for horror role-play
- Creepy skins

items.title: Trick or Treat
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description: Go trick or treating in a Halloween-themed city! Most neighbors give you candy. Play tricks on the greedy neighbors that don't. Buy costumes to hide your identity and weapons to fight scary monsters.

items.title: Advanced Weapons
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Enjoy new weapons and spells added to your survival experience! Craft new materials, spells, and new types of weapons in this world!

+ 60+ new weapons
+ 10 new spells
+ Craftable!
+ Secret survival base
+ 2 free skins!

items.title: Scary Vampires
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Scary vampires have captured Jimmy! Take the train to Dracula's castle, if you dare! Defeat many monsters along the way, including vampires and grim reapers. Save Jimmy before the vampires turn him into a bat!
- 6 scary monsters
- Boss battles
- Unicycles
- Ride a train
- A story with cutscenes

You've faced scary clowns and dolls; vampires are next!

items.title: Spooky Pumpkins
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description:
These scary-looking pumpkins are alive and climbing out of the pumpkin patch! From slime-oozing to a fire-breathing pumpkin, stand out and be the spookiest with these terrifyingly detailed skins! 
-HD

items.title: Crafty Costumes
items.creator: Minecraft
items.description: It’s time for a graveyard smash! From October first to Halloween night, the Crafty Costumes Skin Pack is available for free with purchase of another Minecraft item from one of our partnered retailers. With creepy costumes like the Mummy Maria and Swamp Monster Samir, you’ll have all the dress up options you would need for the spookiest day of the year!

items.title: Anime Idols 3
items.creator: DogHouse
items.description:
Transform yourself into your favourite anime character and impress everybody!

- 12 skins
-perfect for roleplay
-have fun!

items.title: Epic Miners
items.creator: Glowfischdesigns
items.description:
Why walk in the open air if you can be a miner instead? 
Join the mining company and wear your favorite outfit!
Go on an adventure together with your friends and start looking for diamonds with these amazing skins!


+ 2 free skins!
+ 13 epic mining skins in total!

items.title: Spooky Anime
items.creator: DogHouse
items.description:
Booh! Your favourite anime characters aren't only looking cool right now but also pretty spooky.

-14 skins
-perfect for halloween
-have fun!
